metadata.title: कोंकणी बांस की भाजी कैसे बनाते हैं । How to cook bamboo Shoot । Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
There are three major tribes in Dang district of Gujarat. These tribes are Bhil, Konkani and Warli. The tribes of Dang have a very different style of cooking food. They use lots of garlic and red chillis in their food. In this episode we take you to a small village called Lavariya, and show you how they cook stuffed Bamboo and local lentils.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below::
